journey.name: recovered payment success amount
journey.description: iOS recovery display regression. Requires a disposable regtest wallet with an unresolved on-chain payment request A for 10000 sats and a different unpaid request B for 20000 sats. Retain B's draft while opening A's original Pending recovery. Creating the unresolved receipt is a manual fixture prerequisite outside the Capabilities table; label seeded state as state injection, not a reproduced native failure. Use the original-payment retry flow and fresh fee and PIN approval as required. Record A's wallet and transaction ID. Never use real BTC or USDT.

actions.action: Verify the retained Pending payment shows A's original 10000 sats and transaction ID while B remains unpaid
Complete A through the original-payment recovery flow with fresh fee and PIN approval when required
Verify Bitcoin Sent shows A's 10000 sats, never B's 20000-sat draft; while activity is loading no amount is shown
Tap Details and verify the amount and transaction ID match A in its original wallet
